TechnologyStack.Framework: Go HTTP API, PostgreSQL, MinIO, Python workers, CopperASR runtime submodule, React Web UI, Telegram adapter, MCP adapter

ArchitectureShape.goal: Make the API the durable product authority for media accumulation, curation, execution, artifacts, diagnostics, channel recovery, idempotency, and retention.
ArchitectureShape.canonical-chain: media_asset -> collection/inbox -> immutable selection_snapshot -> analysis_run -> analysis_run_step/artifacts -> artifact_subject lineage; one media_asset -> export_job -> transient delivery object is an independent execution chain
ArchitectureShape.control-plane: Go API owns target public contracts, channel_account scope, lifecycle transitions, validation, operation_requests, retention policy, diagnostics, artifact metadata, and channel_surface recovery state.
ArchitectureShape.execution-plane: Python workers consume sealed selection_snapshot material and declared analysis_run_step_inputs through internal execution contracts.
ArchitectureShape.queue-plane: PostgreSQL analysis_run_steps, metadata_enrichment_jobs, and export_jobs are separate durable worker queues; claims use expiring leases and per-attempt fencing tokens.
ArchitectureShape.object-plane: MinIO stores stored_object bodies for media assets, previews, generated artifacts, private execution evidence, and diagnostic bundles behind API-issued access decisions.
ArchitectureShape.adapters: Telegram, Web, and MCP are thin clients over the same API-owned media_asset, collection, selection_snapshot, analysis_run, artifact, diagnostic, channel_account, and channel_surface state.

component.role: Go HTTP API, WebSocket server, storage orchestrator, and channel-account-scoped product authority
Python transcript assembly and speech transcription behind analysis_run_steps, including ordered inline and object-backed text materials
External pinned CopperASR source submodule for the dedicated ASR runtime service
Python report and research execution behind analysis_run_steps
Python YouTube export and uploaded-video audio conversion behind export_jobs
React management UI for inbox, collections, selections, runs, artifacts, and diagnostics
Thin Telegram capture, rendering, and recovery adapter over API-owned state
Thin MCP tool adapter over API-owned state
OpenAPI and JSON schema source for target vocabulary

table.name: channel_accounts
table.purpose: Durable external channel identities for the single human user.
table.fields: id, channel, external_account_ref, display_name, status, metadata, created_at, updated_at, last_seen_at, disabled_at
table.rules: Channel accounts are access and recovery scope, not product owners or workspaces.

table.name: operation_requests
table.purpose: Idempotency and audit records for accepted mutating channel operations.
table.fields: id, channel_account_id, operation_type, idempotency_key, request_hash, status, target_type, target_id, error_code, metadata, created_at, completed_at
table.rules: Retries must be deterministic and conflict-aware.

table.name: stored_objects
table.purpose: Shared object storage metadata for input media and output artifacts.
table.fields: id, channel_account_id, bucket, object_key, staging_key, generation, generation_published_at, content_type, size_bytes, checksum_algorithm, checksum, storage_status, retention_state, hold_state, last_successful_use_at, created_at, expires_at, delete_owner, delete_token, delete_lease_expires_at, delete_attempts, deleted_at
table.rules: Unique channel_account_id plus SHA-256 plus size identifies physical uploaded bytes independent of filename. Publishing, re-upload generation, pinning, deletion, and reconciliation are fenced while historical metadata survives body expiry.

table.name: media_assets
table.purpose: Channel-account-scoped durable input records independent of execution.
table.fields: id, channel_account_id, stored_object_id, origin_type, origin_ref, kind, display_name, status, metadata, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
table.rules: Accepted media assets land in inbox by default; invalid assets remain visible through diagnostics.

table.name: collections
table.purpose: Mutable channel-account-scoped groups, including the default inbox.
table.fields: id, channel_account_id, kind, name, status, version, created_at, updated_at, archived_at, deleted_at
table.rules: Collection membership is mutable and version checked; collection edits never mutate sealed snapshots.

table.name: collection_items
table.purpose: Ordered membership between collections and media_asset records.
table.fields: id, collection_id, media_asset_id, position, added_via_channel_account_id, added_at, removed_at
table.rules: Active membership has unique asset and position constraints per collection.

table.name: selection_snapshots
table.purpose: Immutable ordered snapshots prepared for analysis.
table.fields: id, channel_account_id, source_collection_id, status, option_snapshot, diagnostics, created_via_channel_account_id, created_at, sealed_at
table.rules: Selection snapshots are never recomputed from later collection state and storage rejects direct update/delete attempts.

table.name: selection_snapshot_items
table.purpose: Frozen item facts consumed by workers.
table.fields: id, selection_snapshot_id, position, media_asset_id, kind, display_name, origin_snapshot, storage_snapshot, metadata_snapshot, status_at_selection, diagnostics
table.rules: Workers read snapshot facts, not mutable collection rows.

table.name: analysis_runs
table.purpose: User-facing execution records created from selection_snapshots.
table.fields: id, channel_account_id, selection_snapshot_id, run_type, status, version, idempotency_key, params, delivery, evidence_gate_state, created_via_channel_account_id, created_at, started_at, completed_at, cancel_requested_at, canceled_at, expires_at
table.rules: Public clients address analysis_run; internal steps remain behind it.

table.name: analysis_run_steps
table.purpose: Internal worker-visible step, claim, heartbeat, retry, and finalization state.
table.fields: id, analysis_run_id, step_kind, worker_kind, status, attempt_no, lease_owner, claimed_at, heartbeat_at, finalized_at, metadata, created_at
table.rules: Steps are internal execution records, not public product objects.

table.name: analysis_run_step_inputs
table.purpose: Declared immutable inputs a worker step may read.
table.fields: id, analysis_run_step_id, input_kind, selection_snapshot_item_id, artifact_id, position, required, metadata, created_at
table.rules: Report and research steps consume transcript/text-corpus artifacts when speech prerequisites exist; active worker code materializes declared artifact inputs instead of discovering raw speech media.

table.name: analysis_run_events
table.purpose: Append-only run status, artifact, and diagnostic timeline.
table.fields: id, analysis_run_id, event_type, version, status, payload, created_at
table.rules: Events power polling and WebSocket updates.

table.name: export_jobs
table.purpose: API-owned one-material download and conversion lifecycle independent of analysis collections.
table.fields: id, channel_account_id, media_asset_id, operation, variant, status, version, idempotency_key, retry_generation, attempt_no, attempt_token, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, heartbeat_at, max_attempts, progress, output_stored_object_id, diagnostic_id, created_at, started_at, completed_at, cancel_requested_at, canceled_at, expires_at
table.rules: Only normalized semantic variants are public; provider format ids remain worker details. Owner plus attempt-token compare-and-set fences every active mutation and stale leases are reclaimable. Export lifecycle never mutates collection membership or analysis_run state.

table.name: metadata_enrichment_jobs
table.purpose: API-owned YouTube reference metadata queue independent from export and analysis execution.
table.fields: id, media_asset_id, channel_account_id, provider, canonical_url, status, version, idempotency_key, attempt_no, max_attempts, attempt_token, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, heartbeat_at, next_attempt_at, progress, error_code, error_message, created_at, started_at, completed_at
table.rules: URL ingestion atomically enqueues the initial idempotent row. Owner plus attempt-token fences claims, progress, and finalize; heartbeats preserve the claimed lease duration, retries and stale-lease reclaim use bounded backoff, and successful finalize changes only current media_asset metadata.

table.name: export_deliveries
table.purpose: Fenced adapter delivery and finite output-retention protection.
table.fields: id, export_job_id, channel_account_id, channel, status, version, attempt_no, attempt_token, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, max_attempts, expires_at, delivered_at, failure_code
table.rules: Telegram acknowledges only after send; Web link issuance preserves access until its fixed window expires.

table.name: stored_object_pins
table.purpose: Transactional source or delivery protection against physical retention deletion.
table.fields: id, stored_object_id, owner_type, owner_id, purpose, expires_at, created_at, released_at
table.rules: Pin insertion succeeds only while the stored object is available; delete scheduling proves no active pins under the same row lock. Workload pins have null expires_at through queued/active work and release on every terminal transition. Retry reacquires them after availability validation. Delivery pins use finite expires_at.

table.name: artifacts
table.purpose: Run outputs, previews, evidence objects, and downloadable files.
table.fields: id, channel_account_id, analysis_run_id, stored_object_id, kind, status, content_type, checksum, size_bytes, visibility, preview, created_at, expires_at, deleted_at
table.rules: Artifact access is mediated by the API and scoped through channel_account plus run; worker-published artifacts create stored_object metadata and artifact_subject lineage.

table.name: artifact_subjects
table.purpose: Lineage links from artifacts to runs, steps, snapshots, selected items, media assets, or diagnostics.
table.fields: id, artifact_id, subject_type, subject_id, subject_role, created_at
table.rules: Lineage removes guessing from worker and UI artifact resolution.

table.name: diagnostics
table.purpose: Structured failure, warning, and operator evidence for target subjects.
table.fields: id, channel_account_id, subject_type, subject_id, severity, code, message, context, safe_channel_context, correlation_id, remediation_hint, created_at
table.rules: Rejected records and partial failures are represented as diagnostics, not hidden drops.

table.name: channel_surfaces
table.purpose: Restart-safe external presentation mappings for Telegram, Web recovery surfaces, or future channels.
table.fields: id, channel_account_id, channel, surface_type, surface_key, address, address_fingerprint, display_state, lifecycle_status, version, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at, last_rendered_at, superseded_at, deleted_at
table.rules: Channel surfaces cannot drive product lifecycle.

table.name: channel_surface_subjects
table.purpose: Links from channel surfaces to represented product or diagnostic subjects.
table.fields: surface_id, subject_type, subject_id, subject_role, created_at
table.rules: One primary subject per surface is allowed.

table.name: channel_surface_events
table.purpose: Append-only operational history for channel surface recovery and delivery investigations.
table.fields: id, surface_id, event_type, reason, previous_version, next_version, actor_type, actor_id, metadata, created_at
table.rules: Delivery failures remain channel evidence and do not mutate product entities.

LifecycleAndRetention.status-source: Lifecycle statuses are defined in docs/requirements.xml and mirrored in packages/contracts schemas.
LifecycleAndRetention.retention-rule: Soft-deleted media_assets and collection membership are hidden from default reads but retained until policy permits hard deletion.
Selection snapshots remain immutable audit snapshots even if stored object bodies later expire.
Artifacts can expire independently from run metadata; diagnostics explain unavailable artifacts.
Deletion and export workflows must include media_asset, stored_object, collection, selection_snapshot, analysis_run, artifact, artifact_subject, diagnostic, and channel_surface records.

MEDIA_OBJECT_RETENTION_DAYS defaults to seven and controls each uploaded source generation and generated export body independently from delivery/access TTL; source re-publication advances generation_published_at while preserving original created_at.

The API maintenance loop reclaims expired metadata-enrichment and export leases before retention reconciliation and sweeping; reconciliation dry-run never advances persistent cursors or mutates object state.

A one-time metadata-only upgrade may enqueue existing supported YouTube URL assets after canonicalizing exactly one video id; it stores no provider media bytes and invalid legacy references terminate with a stable diagnostic.
Stored-object publication uses attempt-owned staging, SHA-256 plus size uniqueness scoped by channel_account, deterministic managed keys, collision rejection, and reconciled losing uploads.

Source and delivery pins are acquired only while storage_status=available. Delete scheduling atomically proves no active pins, moves the row to delete_scheduled, and blocks new work before physical deletion.
Delete claims and export/delivery work carry owner, random token, finite lease, attempts, and compare-and-set transitions; stale claims are safely reclaimed.
YouTube source media is attempt-scoped scratch only; generated export output is a transient delivery object and becomes eligible immediately after successful delivery.
Application retention state is canonical. Bucket lifecycle rules are allowed only as a safety backstop for transient prefixes.
LifecycleAndRetention.workspace-rule: S3-compatible storage is the durable byte authority; workers stream S3 bodies in bounded chunks into token-unique seekable attempt files without whole-object RAM buffering, remove partial downloads on failure, remove workspaces in outer finally paths, and periodically reap abandoned workspaces only after API lease expiry plus grace or absolute TTL.
LifecycleAndRetention.security-rule: Compose binds every private-state host port, including API and MinIO API/console, to 127.0.0.1. Public middleware rejects hostile Host and every disallowed non-empty Origin before handlers, including multipart; internal routes require PLATFORM_INTERNAL_TOKEN; output DTOs never expose object keys and access rechecks ownership plus succeeded/available state.
LifecycleAndRetention.operations-rule: Additive forward-only data migrations and disabled workers precede adapter rollout; export claims are enabled before retention sweeps. Historical stored-object aliases and provider URLs are repaired forward without destructive Down sections. Application rollback disables claims/sweeps, drains leases, and preserves additive tables. Physical deletion is irreversible.
LifecycleAndRetention.configuration: MEDIA_OBJECT_RETENTION_DAYS=7; RETENTION_SWEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS=300; RETENTION_BATCH_SIZE=100; RETENTION_CLAIM_SECONDS=120; OBJECT_ORPHAN_GRACE_MINUTES=60; EXPORT_DELIVERY_TTL_HOURS=24; EXPORT_DELIVERY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=5; EXPORT_WEB_ACCESS_TTL_HOURS=24; WORKSPACE_ORPHAN_GRACE_MINUTES=30; WORKSPACE_ABSOLUTE_TTL_HOURS=24; MEDIA_EXPORT_MAX_DURATION_SECONDS=14400; MEDIA_EXPORT_MAX_INPUT_BYTES=4294967296; MEDIA_EXPORT_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES=2147483648; MEDIA_EXPORT_WORKSPACE_MAX_BYTES=6442450944; MEDIA_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=1800; MEDIA_EXPORT_CONCURRENCY=1.
LifecycleAndRetention.observability: Stable diagnostics and maintenance logs cover provider resolution, export lease reclaim, retention claim/delete/reconcile, missing bodies, and workspace cleanup failure. Delivery failure codes are durable on fenced attempts; reclaim, reconcile, and sweep endpoints return structured counters. No dedicated metrics backend for queue age, retained/workspace bytes, or retry histograms is claimed by this packet.

AsrRuntime.contract: media-analysis-platform owns analysis_run_steps, media_assets, selection_snapshots, analysis_runs, progress, cancellation, artifacts, diagnostics, and channel surfaces. CopperASR owns ASR model lifecycle, inference, sanitized ASR errors, /health, and /transcribe.
AsrRuntime.artifact-contract: TranscriptResult carries provider_metadata so run_manifest can identify CopperASR provider, model, duration, and sanitized runtime metadata while visible transcript artifacts remain plain text, markdown, and DOCX.
AsrRuntime.target-topology: Dedicated internal CopperASR HTTP runtime service consumed by workers/transcription through COPPER_ASR_BASE_URL.
AsrRuntime.provider-policy: CopperASR ONNX VAD delegates execution-provider selection to the installed ONNX Runtime. The local compose image installs the cpu extra, so this project keeps the existing CPU-only local runtime profile unless a later packet explicitly changes the image extra and benchmark envelope. The consumer mounts COPPER_ASR_CACHE_DIR on the copper-asr-cache volume; CopperASR owns the internal model and VAD cache fanout.
AsrRuntime.dependency-policy: Root Python dependencies stay free of removed legacy ASR packages; CopperASR runtime dependencies are isolated in the dedicated image and submodule runtime.
AsrRuntime.cleanup-policy: Legacy ASR imports, model-conversion helpers, provider-specific env, old model-cache volumes, fallback tests, and dual-backend switches are removed and must not remain active fallback behavior.
AsrRuntime.guardrail: Active runtime, compose, env, dependency manifest, and doc surfaces must continue to reject removed ASR runtime reintroduction outside historical research or migration plans.
AsrRuntime.verification-ref: media-b8s.1.4, media-b8s.1.5, media-b8s.1.6, media-b8s.1.7, media-b8s.1.8, media-b8s.1.9, media-b8s.1.10, media-b8s.2.5, media-b8s.3.1

AdapterContracts.telegram: Telegram captures input through the local compose Telegram Bot API server, resolves channel_account scope, creates media_assets, shows inbox or collection state, creates selection_snapshots, starts analysis_run records, persists current_materials_panel, analysis_task_surface, and result_artifact_surface channel_surfaces, recovers active surfaces after restart, and sends artifact previews or downloads returned by the API. New YouTube audio export actions wait for provider title and performer metadata before freezing the M4A/AAC output profile and presentation snapshot; video export remains independently available while enrichment is pending. Authenticated audio/mp4 downloads with a music presentation map to send_audio with bounded title, performer, and duration and no generic caption. Historical audio/ogg, audio/opus, and application/ogg downloads, including parameterized MIME values, remain on send_voice, generic audio retains send_audio, and non-audio keeps send_document. Result deduplication requires a valid Telegram surface address; stale addressless result surfaces are superseded and delivery is retried.
AdapterContracts.web: Web provides management UI for materials, groups, selections, progress, results, downloads, errors, and retention over target public API contracts. Service ASR metadata from run_manifest remains hidden from normal human result views.
AdapterContracts.mcp: MCP exposes stable tools over the same API and never maintains its own durable media store. MCP artifact preview tools can return CopperASR run_manifest metadata for explicit service artifact reads.

EvidenceContracts.contract-evidence: Schema tests must prove target DTOs and route names exist, removed aliases are absent, and stale public product vocabulary does not appear in target operations.
EvidenceContracts.storage-evidence: Storage tests must cover target migration fragments, channel-scoped digest identity, staged publication and reconciliation, atomic processing launch, pin/delete fencing, metadata enrichment enqueue/lease/retry/finalize/reclaim transitions, export/delivery lease transitions, physical deletion, immutable selection snapshots, operation_request idempotency, diagnostics, channel_surface supersede rules, and artifact_subject lineage.
EvidenceContracts.api-evidence: API tests must cover ingestion with atomic YouTube enrichment enqueue, account-scoped refresh, token-protected enrichment queue/claim/progress/finalize/reclaim, bounded provider metadata, collection mutation, selection_snapshot sealing, analysis_run retry/restore, export create/cancel/retry, delivery claim/ack/fail, scoped output access, retention operations, and diagnostics queries.
EvidenceContracts.worker-evidence: Worker tests must cover step/metadata/export queue polling, owner-token claim/progress/finalize, sealed input consumption, provider metadata bounds, staged output publication, cancellation/process-group termination, resource limits, attempt-unique outer-finally cleanup, lease-aware reaping, diagnostics, and restart recovery.
EvidenceContracts.asr-evidence: ASR evidence must cover CopperASR HTTP client configuration, service health, transcript artifact publication, sanitized provider metadata in run_manifest, stable asr_* diagnostics, hidden provider internals in normal Telegram/Web surfaces, explicit MCP service artifact previews, compose topology, and no-legacy runtime guardrails.
EvidenceContracts.adapter-evidence: Adapter tests must prove Telegram, Web, and MCP operate over the same API-owned state and do not expose grouped submission modes as durable product state. Telegram tests must also prove target channel_account media_asset, selection_snapshot, analysis_run, artifact, and diagnostic request shapes plus channel_surface restart recovery, result duplicate prevention, supersede behavior, custom local Bot API server session configuration, native music send_audio metadata, OGG/Opus and application/ogg delivery through send_voice, generic audio compatibility, non-audio send_document fallback, and metadata-pending export gating. Web tests must prove the YouTube audio control is unavailable until the same provider title and performer facts are ready while video export remains available.
EvidenceContracts.runtime-evidence: Runtime smoke must prove real uploads and remote references can be ingested, atomically selected and analyzed, exported and delivered, restarted safely, reused by digest, cleaned from scratch/transient storage, and physically expired from MinIO while metadata persists.
